title: Protocol to purify and detect ubiquitinated phospholipids in budding yeast and human cell lines
author: Sakamaki, Mizushima
materials: Mouse monoclonal anti-FLAG (clone M2) affinity gel

Timing: 4 days
Note: Glutathione S-transferase (GST)-ubiquilin 1 ubiquitin-associated domain (UQ1 UBA) is used to capture endogenous ubiquitin. When 3xFLAG-Ub-PE is detected, this step can be skipped.
5.For the affinity purification of endogenous Ub-PE, prepare GST-UQ1 UBA9 as follows. troubleshooting 2.a.Transform BL21 cells with pGEX6p-UQ1 UBA and culture at 37°C for 12–18 h.b.Inoculate 5 mL of 2× yeast extract tryptone (2xYT) + carbenicillin in a 50-mL tube (e.g., Thermo Fisher Scientific, Cat#: 339652) with a colony of the transformant and culture with shaking at 200 rpm at 37°C for 12–18 h.c.Transfer the culture to 200 mL of 2xTY + carbenicillin in a 500-mL flask and culture with shaking at 160 rpm at 30°C for 4 h.d.Add 100 μL of 1 M isopropyl-β-d(-)-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG) (final concentration, 0.5 mM) and culture with shaking at 160 rpm at 30°C for 4 h.e.Collect cells by centrifugation at 2,900 × g for 5 min.f.Resuspend cells in 10 mL of ice-cold CelLytic B containing proteinase inhibitor cocktail and 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), transfer the cell suspension to a 50-mL tube, and incubate on ice for 15 min.g.Sonicate for 10 s, twice (Astrason, model# XL2020; strength, 3.5).h.Remove cell debris by centrifugation at 4°C at 17,700 × g for 10 min.i.Pass the supernatant through a 0.45-μm pore filter and transfer it to a 15-mL tube.j.Incubate the supernatant with 1 mL of glutathione Sepharose 4B (50% in CelLytic B buffer) at 4°C for 12–18 h using a rotator.k.Wash the beads with 1 mL of ice-cold CelLytic B reagent three times.l.Wash the beads with 1 mL of ice-cold Triton X-114 wash/dilution buffer three times.m.Store the beads in 500 μL of Triton X-114 wash/dilution buffer (50% in buffer) at 4°C.n.To confirm that GST-UQ1 UBA is properly generated, mix 5 μL of GST-UQ1 UBA with 1 μL of 6× SDS-PAGE sample buffer and perform SDS polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) followed by Coomassie brilliant blue (CBB) staining. GST-UQ1 UBA should be detected at approximately 31 kDa.
Note: To spin down the beads, centrifuge at 4°C at 1,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Grow yeast for tagged Ub-PE
steps.instruction: Inoculate three 16‑mL culture tubes each with 4 mL synthetic defined‑casamino acid (SD‑CA, –Ura) medium containing BY4741 cells harboring pRS316‑GPD‑3×FLAG‑Ub; culture at 30 °C on a rotator (TAITEC RT‑50N, speed 7) until OD₆₀₀≈1.0 (log phase).

substeps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 1,000 × g for 5 min in a 15‑mL tube.
Wash the pellet with 1 mL ddH₂O and keep on ice for the next step.

steps.title: Grow yeast for endogenous Ub-PE
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL YPD medium in a 300‑mL flask with BY4741 cells and culture with shaking at 150 rpm at 30 °C until OD₆₀₀≈1.0.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 1,000 × g for 5 min in a 50‑mL tube.
Wash the pellet with 5 mL ddH₂O and keep on ice for the next step.

steps.title: Seed HeLa for tagged Ub-PE
steps.instruction: Plate HeLa cells stably expressing 3×FLAG‑Ub into two 10‑cm dishes containing DMEM complete medium; culture 2–3 days until ~80 % confluence.

substeps.instruction: Remove medium and wash cells with 10 mL ice‑cold PBS.
Scrape cells into 1 mL ice‑cold PBS, transfer to a 1.5‑mL tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; discard supernatant and keep the pellet for the next step.

steps.title: Seed HeLa for endogenous Ub-PE
steps.instruction: Plate HeLa cells into ten 10‑cm dishes with DMEM complete medium; culture 2–3 days until ~80 % confluence.

substeps.instruction: Remove medium and wash each dish with 10 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL ice‑cold PBS to each dish, scrape cells, and pool into a 15‑mL tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; discard supernatant and keep the pellet for the next step.

steps.title: Prepare GST‑UQ1 UBA beads
steps.instruction: Produce GST‑UQ1 UBA in BL21 cells and immobilize on glutathione Sepharose 4B.

substeps.instruction: Transform BL21 with pGEX6p‑UQ1 UBA; incubate at 37 °C for 12–18 h.
Inoculate 5 mL 2×YT + carbenicillin in a 50‑mL tube with a colony; shake 200 rpm, 37 °C for 12–18 h.
Transfer to 200 mL 2×YT + carbenicillin in a 500‑mL flask; shake 160 rpm, 30 °C for 4 h.
Add 100 µL 1 M IPTG (final 0.5 mM) and shake 160 rpm, 30 °C for 4 h.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 2,900 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL ice‑cold CelLytic B containing protease inhibitor cocktail and 1 mM DTT; incubate on ice 15 min.
Sonicate twice for 10 s (Astrason XL2020, strength 3.5).
Centrifuge at 4 °C, 17,700 × g for 10 min; filter supernatant through a 0.45‑µm filter.
Incubate supernatant with 1 mL glutathione Sepharose 4B (50 % in CelLytic B) at 4 °C for 12–18 h with rotation.
Wash beads three times with 1 mL ice‑cold CelLytic B.
Wash beads three times with 1 mL ice‑cold Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer.
Store beads in 500 µL Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer (50 % in buffer) at 4 °C.
Spin beads when needed at 4 °C, 1,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Isolate yeast total membranes
steps.instruction: Lyse yeast cells and collect membrane fraction by ultracentrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the harvested yeast pellet in 500 µL ice‑cold disruption buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail.
Transfer to a 2‑mL tube with ~500 µL 0.5 mm zirconium dioxide beads.
Disrupt cells using a multi‑beads shocker at 2,700 rpm, 30 s on/30 s off, twice.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min to remove intact cells, debris, and nuclei.
Collect 25 µL of the supernatant and mix with 5 µL 6× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer (total‑lysate control).
Ultracentrifuge the remaining supernatant at 100,000 × g, 4 °C for 1 h.
Discard the supernatant (cytosol) and keep the membrane pellet for the next step.

steps.title: Isolate HeLa total membranes
steps.instruction: Lyse HeLa cells from two 10‑cm dishes and collect membrane fraction.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL ice‑cold homogenization buffer.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL ice‑cold homogenization buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail; incubate on ice 10 min.
Disrupt cells by passing the suspension through a 27‑gauge needle and syringe 20 strokes.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min to remove remaining debris and nuclei.
Collect 25 µL of the supernatant and mix with 5 µL 6× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer (total‑lysate control).
Ultracentrifuge the remaining supernatant at 100,000 × g, 4 °C for 1 h.
Discard the supernatant (cytosol) and keep the membrane pellet for the next step.

steps.title: Triton X‑114 phase partitioning
steps.instruction: Separate hydrophobic proteins (detergent phase) from aqueous proteins using Triton X‑114.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the membrane pellet in 200 µL ice‑cold Triton X‑114 buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail.
Centrifuge at 16,900 × g, 4 °C for 10 min; transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5‑mL tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for ~1 min until the solution becomes cloudy.
Centrifuge at 25 °C, 16,900 × g for 10 min.
Remove the top aqueous layer (≈180 µL first round, ≈500 µL in subsequent washes).
Add 500 µL Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer, mix well, and place on ice until clear (few minutes).
Repeat the heat‑centrifuge‑remove‑add‑ice cycle two more times for a total of three washes.
After the third wash, add 500 µL Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail to the detergent phase.
Place on ice until clear, then centrifuge at 16,900 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.
Transfer ~520 µL of the clear detergent supernatant to a new 1.5‑mL tube; this contains hydrophobic ubiquitin species.

steps.title: Anti‑FLAG immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Capture 3×FLAG‑Ub from the detergent phase with anti‑FLAG M2 affinity beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash anti‑FLAG M2 beads three times with 1 mL Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer.
Add 20 µL anti‑FLAG M2 beads (50 % in Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer) to the detergent sample.
Incubate at 4 °C for 12–18 h with rotation.
Wash beads three times with 500 µL Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500 µL ddH₂O.
Proceed to downstream analysis or add 50 µL 1× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer and store at –20 °C (pause point).

steps.title: GST‑UQ1 UBA pull‑down
steps.instruction: Capture endogenous ubiquitin (including Ub‑PE) from the detergent phase using GST‑UQ1 UBA beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL GST‑UQ1 UBA immobilized on glutathione Sepharose (50 % in Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer) to the detergent sample.
Incubate at 4 °C for 12–18 h with rotation.
Wash beads three times with 500 µL Triton X‑114 wash/dilution buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500 µL ddH₂O.
Proceed to downstream analysis or add 50 µL 1× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer and store at –20 °C (pause point).

steps.title: Validate GST‑UQ1 UBA preparation
steps.instruction: Confirm the GST‑UQ1 UBA fusion protein by SDS‑PAGE and Coomassie staining.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL GST‑UQ1 UBA bead suspension with 1 µL 6× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer.
Run the sample on an SDS‑PAGE gel and stain with Coomassie brilliant blue.
A band at ~31 kDa indicates successful preparation.
